title: glyph v3: one render, 50 lines, verdict first
description: The 12-line chat budget over-corrected. glyph 3.0 draws one render per reply, up to about 50 lines and 76 cells wide, verdict first: header meter, traffic-light sections, icon / label / bar / value / action rows, per-section totals, an arithmetic summary line and caveat lines. Before and after on the same disk question, the eight-part anatomy, the closed status set plus the new domain-icon legend.
